relationships.evidence_quote: The histological studies, including HE and SF staining, demonstrated that the boundary between AF and NP was disrupted severely, and NP cells decreased severely without vacuoles in USP11−/− group, which indicated that KO of USP11 resulted in more severe IVDD compared with WT group.

key_findings: USP11 binds and deubiquitinates (Lys48 chains) Sirt3, stabilizing it and suppressing oxidative stress-induced ferroptosis in nucleus pulposus cells.
Sirt3 or USP11 knockout worsens IVDD and pain-related behavior; Sirt3 overexpression rescues USP11 knockout.
